one_liner: Global ecommerce platform providing APIs for managing stores, products, orders, and customers.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth authorization code grant flow for standalone/API-only apps and client credentials grant for organization stores, using access tokens in request headers.
gate_notes: Creating a partner account and development store is self-serve and free.
verdict_reason: Shopify offers robust REST and GraphQL APIs with extensive documentation and self-serve developer access, making it fully ready for AI agent integration.

extras.rate_limit_note: Leaky bucket algorithm based on cost for GraphQL and rate limits per second for REST.

evidence.quote: To call a Shopify API, your code sends an access token in a request header to authenticate the identity that token represents (your app or a buyer)
Use the OAuth authorization code grant flow to get access tokens for standalone and API-only apps that live outside the Shopify admin.
